name: Isekai Sakaba no Sextet ~Vol.2 Adventurer's Days~
original_name: 異世界酒場のセクステット ～Vol.2 Adventurer's Days～
source:
One day, several days after our protagonist the young cook in the back of an Akihabara maid cafe got transported to another world, our hero gets paid a visit by the lady knight Dahlia at Lupine's tavern.
Dahlia proclaims to the hero, "I want you to make me a woman," which leads to all kinds of misunderstandings with Lupine and Daisy, who have a barrage of questions!

After getting filled in on what she actually meant, it's revealed that Dahlia's aim is to defeat a monster who only preys on women. However, for Dahlia, who has only ever lived by the sword, femininity feels like an alien concept.

To help increase her feminine charms, Dahlia becomes a waitress at Lupine's Tavern, and her inexperience leads to all kinds of trouble with the guests!

Our hero has no idea that this turn of events will lead him to help Dahlia and Veronica take down their archnemesis from the past...

[Official description from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461770/Fantasy_Tavern_Sextet_Vol2_Adventurers_Days/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，就在秋叶原女仆咖啡馆后面的年轻厨师被传送到另一个世界几天后的一天，我们的英雄在卢平的酒馆里受到了女骑士达莉亚的拜访。
达莉亚向英雄宣称：“我要你让我成为一个女人”，这导致了卢平和黛西之间的各种误会，他们提出了一连串的问题！

在了解了她的真正意思后，人们发现达莉亚的目标是打败一个只捕食女性的怪物。然而，对于一直靠剑为生的达莉亚来说，女性气质感觉像是一个陌生的概念。

为了增加自己的女性魅力，达莉亚成为了卢平酒馆的一名女服务员，但她的经验不足给客人带来了各种各样的麻烦！

我们的英雄不知道这一事件的转变将导致他帮助达莉亚和维罗妮卡击败他们过去的宿敌……

[官方描述来自 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461770/Fantasy_Tavern_Sextet_Vol2_Adventurers_Days/]Steam[/url]]
